name: agent_image_routing_sniff_mime_from_bytes
notes: Magic-byte MIME sniffing (image_routing_ports.c vs LIVE agent/image_routing.py). Inputs are hex-encoded bytes (binary is not argv-safe). DOCUMENTED DIVERGENCES (excluded inputs): the C port checks JPEG before PNG (LIVE orders PNG first), accepts any FF D8 pair as JPEG where LIVE requires FF D8 FF, accepts any 'GIF' prefix where LIVE requires GIF87a/GIF89a, knows only heic/avif brands where LIVE has the full HEIC set, and entirely lacks LIVE's BMP/TIFF/ICO/SVG rungs; also C returns NULL for len<4 including 3-byte payloads LIVE would sniff. The gate exercises only inputs where LIVE and C agree on both outcome and the port's ladder.
